import numpy as np

def test_predict_8_years():
    X = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]).reshape(-1, 1)
    y = np.array([30, 35, 38, 42, 48, 52, 58, 68, 75])
    result = exercise.train_and_predict(X, y, 8)
    assert 60 <= result <= 65, f"Expected around 63 for 8 years, got {result}"

def test_predict_3_years():
    X = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 9, 10]).reshape(-1, 1)
    y = np.array([30, 35, 38, 42, 48, 52, 58, 68, 75])
    result = exercise.train_and_predict(X, y, 3)
    assert 37 <= result <= 40, f"Expected around 38 for 3 years, got {result}"

def test_predict_0_years():
    X = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]).reshape(-1, 1)
    y = np.array([40, 45, 50, 55, 60])
    result = exercise.train_and_predict(X, y, 0)
    assert 34 <= result <= 37, f"Expected around 35 for 0 years, got {result}"

def test_predict_outside_range():
    X = np.array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5]).reshape(-1, 1)
    y = np.array([10, 20, 30, 40, 50])
    result = exercise.train_and_predict(X, y, 10)
    assert result >= 90, f"Extrapolating to 10 years should give >= 90, got {result}"

def test_returns_int():
    X = np.array([1, 2, 3]).reshape(-1, 1)
    y = np.array([5, 10, 15])
    result = exercise.train_and_predict(X, y, 4)
    assert isinstance(result, (int, np.integer)), f"Expected int return type, got {type(result)}"
solution_code:
import numpy as np
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression

def train_and_predict(X, y, predict_for):
    model = LinearRegression()
    model.fit(X, y)
    pred = model.predict([[predict_for]])
    return int(round(pred[0]))

import numpy as np
from sklearn.neighbors import KNeighborsClassifier

def predict_class(X, y, new_sample, k=3):
    knn = KNeighborsClassifier(n_neighbors=k)
    knn.fit(X, y)
    pred = knn.predict(new_sample)
    return int(pred[0])
